Overview

Pergamino is a city in Buenos Aires with a population of 105,000. Northern Buenos Aires province’s agricultural center, known for its grain exchange and farming traditions. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
